sys_app_application.description: Our facilities team currently manages maintenance requests through email and a shared spreadsheet. This has led to lost requests, no SLA visibility, no audit trail for compliance/safety inspections, and no way for leadership to see maintenance spend or technician workload. We are commissioning a scoped ServiceNow application, Facilities & Asset Maintenance Management (scope: x_fac_maint), to replace this process end-to-end. The application must live as an isolated scoped application (not extending global Task/Case tables) so that it can be developed, tested, and updated independently of our existing ITSM implementation, and so Facilities data remains cleanly separated from IT data for licensing and access control purposes. Where cross-application visibility is needed (e.g., an IT-owned asset also tracked in Facilities), we will use reference fields and data lookups rather than table extension.
sys_app_application.title: Facilities Management
